name: @etzhayyim/air-sched-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of air-sched (airline schedule management: flight schedules + airport slots + codeshares) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW). Published schedules = public open-data; no PII/settlement/liability. Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
